title: New York Times and Publishers Sue Brave Browser Over AI Scraping
excerpt: The New York Times and other publications are suing the maker of the Brave web browser over alleged AI scraping and paywall bypassing.
body_html:
The New York Times, alongside several other publications, has filed a lawsuit against the company behind the Brave web browser. The legal action addresses allegations that the browser engaged in unlawful scraping to train artificial intelligence models.

Additionally, the complaint accuses the company of allowing users to bypass publication paywalls. Publications joining the complaint include the New York Daily News and the Chicago Tribune.
